Proof step 1.2 uses complex sinh/cosh definitions, addition identities and derivatives, but F7 cites only the complex exponential Cartesian formula, which does not supply them. Add the complex hyperbolic definition and exact addition/derivative suppliers, and make the real hyperbolic growth uses explicit.
